spans.s:
तोष तोष, अस्, m. (fr. rt. तुष्), satisfaction,
[]
gratification, contentment, pleasure, joy, happiness;
Contentment personified as a son of Bhaga-vat and
one of the twelve Tuṣitas.

तोश तोश, अस्, आ, अम्, or तोशस्, आस्, आस्, अस्
(fr. rt. 1. तुश्), Ved. distilling, trickling, granting.

तोषक, अस्, इका, अम्, gratifying, causing pleasure
or happiness.

तोषण, अस्, ई, अम्, satisfying, gratifying, making
contented, appeasing, pleasing; (अम्), n. the act
of satisfying, satisfaction, gratification, pleasing, de-
lighting; (ई), f. an epithet of Durgā.

तोषणीय or तोषयितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be
satisfied or gratified or made contented, to be
pleased.

तोषित, अस्, आ, अम्, pleased, satisfied, gratified,
appeased.

तोषिन्, ई, इणी, इ, (at the end of a comp.) satisfied
or contented with, pleased with, liking; gladdening,
satisfying, making contented.

तोष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be made satisfied or con-
tented, to be pleased or delighted.

तोषल तोषल or तोसल, आस्, m. pl., N. of
a race (?).
